 Can you hire prostitutes in GTA 6?
 If you’re riding around searching for some action late at night, you might want to read this.
 Bill Lavoy 
 November 18, 2026 3:00 AM 
 Rockstar Games 
 1 
 You’re forgiven if you went for a late-night drive in GTA 6 looking for a little strange. Afterall, soliciting prostitutes in Grand Theft Auto is a tradition as old as Grand Theft Auto 3. Not just soliciting but finding creative ways to get your money back after the fact. Well, if that’s your goal in GTA 6, we need to have a little talk.
 Can you hire prostitutes in GTA 6?
 Source: Rockstar Games 
 No, you cannot solicit prostitutes in GTA 6. Rockstar removed this feature in order to stay true to the spirit of Jason and Lucia’s story. I reached out to Rockstar regarding this decision and received the following reply:
 “GTAVI is a game about a couple in a bind, lovers on the run. While we have taken a lot forward from previous GTA titles, everything we have implemented in VI has been done to support the spirit of the story we wanted to tell, and the gameplay systems we wanted to expand upon - things like wanted system, the radio, robberies and car theft. Many aspects of previous titles are not present in GTAVI, but the elements we have we believe are all necessary and complementary to the feeling and motivations we wanted to emphasize as you play through Jason and Lucia's story.”
 Having played through GTA 6 myself, the only time I was compelled to seek out prostitutes was to verify if they were in the game. Even then I had no desire to cheat on my partner. Jason and Lucia’s journey is so captivating and rewarding as a player that the inclusion of this feature would have felt in poor taste. All the loving you need is waiting for you at home. Just be sure to brush up on your relationship skills if you want to make the most of it.
 Now that you know prostitution has gone the way of the dodo, visit our GTA 6 Strategy Guide for more help. You can also visit our GTA 6 Interactive Map to find everything hidden around Vice City.
